tools.name: refresh_cac_status
tools.description: Ask CAC now for the latest on a registration that's with them (submitted or queried). Changes arrive as system events too.

tools.name: remove_discount_code

tools.name: request_payment
tools.description: Show a Pay button for a registration once its form is complete. The amount comes from FastCAC's pricing (less any discount code applied). You never see card details or the payment link; the outcome arrives as a system event.

tools.name: request_subscription
tools.description: Show a Start free trial button for the Business subscription (for people registering businesses for clients). 14 days free, set up on Paystack.

tools.name: request_whatsapp_verification
tools.description: Show a Verify on WhatsApp button. Needed before starting a business or paying (create_business / request_payment return whatsapp_unverified).

tools.name: revoke_share_link

tools.name: set_share_review
tools.description: Turn on or off the 'review the details' section on a business's live status link.

tools.name: show_share_link
tools.description: Show a Copy button for a business's live share link.

tools.name: update_notification_preferences
tools.description: Turn update channels on or off. Only pass the ones they asked to change.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change their account name (first and/or last name). Not a registration's proprietor name.

tools.description: Save registration form fields from what the user told you. tools.description: Use the photo from their confirmed NIN record as the passport photograph instead of uploading one. Only after they agree, and only once their NIN is confirmed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_knowledge_base" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search FastCAC's knowledge base: the articles, policies, guides and how-tos FastCAC's team has written (pricing and what it includes, refunds, timelines, docume…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_business_name_compliance, search_knowledge_base, get_notification_preferences, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Private data: get_prices, search_knowledge_base, delete_business, fetch_nin_slip, get_action_status, get_cac_documents, get_capabilities, get_credits, get_registration_state, recheck_documents, request_credit_purchase, request_documents, use_nin_photo_for_passport · Public sink: search_knowledge_base, create_share_link, get_notification_preferences, list_share_links, recheck_documents, request_documents, revoke_share_link, set_share_review, show_share_link, update_registration_fields · Destructive: delete_business, recheck_documents, remove_discount_code, remove_whatsapp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_business_name_compliance, search_knowledge_base, get_notification_preferences, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read · Private data: get_prices, search_knowledge_base, delete_business, fetch_nin_slip, get_action_status, get_cac_documents, get_capabilities, get_credits, get_registration_state, recheck_documents, request_credit_purchase, request_documents, use_nin_photo_for_passport · Public sink: search_knowledge_base, create_share_link, get_notification_preferences, list_share_links, recheck_documents, request_documents, revoke_share_link, set_share_review, show_share_link, update_registration_fields · Destructive: delete_business, recheck_documents, remove_discount_code, remove_whatsapp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
